description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an ETL Developer based in San Francisco Bay Area.
This is an opportunity to contribute to a major public-sector technology modernization initiative focused on transforming legacy tax-processing systems. As an ETL Developer, you will design, build, and optimize data integration solutions that support critical applications and business processes. Working primarily with Informatica, you will help ensure data is accurately extracted, transformed, and loaded while maintaining quality, consistency, and performance. You will collaborate with technical teams and client stakeholders to translate business needs into effective technical solutions. The role offers the opportunity to apply your data engineering expertise in an Agile environment while supporting systems that improve operational efficiency and taxpayer experience. This is a fully remote position requiring U.S. citizenship and an active IRS MBI clearance.

Accountabilities
 

 
 Design, develop, build, and configure applications and ETL solutions that meet defined business processes and technical requirements.



 
 Collaborate with client stakeholders and technical teams to understand data needs, gather requirements, and translate them into clear technical specifications.



 
 Develop and maintain Informatica solutions to support data integration and application functionality.



 
 Ensure accurate extraction, transformation, and loading of data into target systems while preserving data integrity and consistency.



 
 Design and implement efficient data workflows, applying data mapping, data cleansing, and workflow automation techniques.



 
 Debug, troubleshoot, and optimize Informatica jobs to improve performance, reliability, and processing efficiency.



 
 Apply data integration best practices and support evolving application and business requirements.



 
 Work collaboratively within Agile development teams, contributing to delivery activities and ongoing solution improvements.



 
 Communicate technical concepts, progress, and solutions effectively to client stakeholders at both technical and organizational levels.




 Requirements:


 
 Bachelor's degree and at least 10 years of relevant professional experience.



 
 U.S. citizenship is required.



 
 Active IRS MBI clearance and current Government-Furnished Equipment (GFE) are required.



 
 Prior experience working within Agile development teams.



 
 Strong experience with ETL development and data integration, particularly using Informatica tools and platforms.



 
 Ability to design, debug, troubleshoot, and optimize ETL jobs and data workflows.



 
 Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with client stakeholders across technical and organizational levels.



 
 Desired skills and experience:



 
 Experience with mainframe environments and DB2.



 
 Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and architectures.



 
 Familiarity with SQL and database management.



 
 Understanding of data integration principles, methodologies, and best practices.






 Benefits:


 
 Annual base salary range of $125,000–$195,000, depending on experience, education, skills, responsibilities, and other business and market considerations.



 
 Competitive compensation packages and performance-based bonuses.



 
 Fully remote work arrangement.



 
 Paid time off available immediately upon joining, prorated based on start date.



 
 Paid parental leave.



 
 Medical, dental, and vision coverage for individuals and families.



 
 Annual budget for training and professional development.



 
 Tuition reimbursement and educational support.



 
 401(k) retirement plan with company matching, fully vested after 60 days of employment.



 
 Collaborative work environment with opportunities for professional growth and career development.
